'''XoXaan's holocron''' was created by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[XoXaan]]. XoXaan was one of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles|exiled]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] after their defeat in the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]. Her holocron was lost in the Tombs of Korriban.

Millennia after her death, former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] accidentally discovered the Holocron and, pretending to be a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]], learned of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] from the Holocron's [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]], and eventually became the student of her teachings in truth, forming the heretical [[One Sith]].
